messages:
maya: Hey team — new Polaris orientation thread. Quick goal: confirm stakeholders + 30-day delivery checkpoints. I want a short list of obvious risks so we can put mitigations in the kickoff doc.

raj: I can take stakeholder map. FYI Polaris legal needs the data flow diagram before we spin up a private deployment. That may add ~1 week if not ready.

tess: PS lead here. My priorities: reduce integration friction and make sure their SRE understands retry/backoff behavior. Can we add SRE office hours in week 2?

leo: Product: adding two acceptance tests to the baseline: a) conversational intent coverage >= 90% on agreed prompts; b) throughput target of 120 qps for their core flows (we can scale later). We'll need sample telemetry during integration to validate.

annie: Enablement: I'll own the training materials and capture feedback. Suggest a short 30-min "power-users" session in week 3. Also pushing a short in-product survey post-launch.

maya: Good notes. Quick asks:
- raj, can you share the stakeholder list by EOD tomorrow?
- tess, please schedule SRE office hours tentatively for Wed week 2.
- leo, do we have a telemetry checklist to share with their SRE?

raj: On it. I'll pull contacts and perms from the AE and share a spreadsheet. Also flag: procurement indicated PO will be in two parts (trial + long-term). If trial PO delayed >10 days, renewal risk increases.

leo: Telemetry checklist: request latency percentiles, error rates split by model/version, token counts, and sample requests. I'll paste a short checklist in here after this message.

annie: For training, recommend two sessions: engineers (deep-dive) + product users (use-cases). I'll also prepare a short slide deck and a checklist for post-session follow-ups.

maya: I'll coordinate with AE on PO cadence and confirm whether sandbox can be used for the initial validation. If sandbox is the only option, we may limit some load tests to later.

onboard-bot: ACTIONS CREATED:
- raj -> stakeholder spreadsheet & data-flow request (due 2d)
- tess -> schedule SRE office hours (due 7d)
- leo -> telemetry checklist (due 1d)
- annie -> training slide deck & power-user session (due 8d)
- maya -> confirm PO split & sandbox constraints with AE (due 1d)

raj: Uploaded stakeholder sheet (internal): https://drive.redwood/polaris/stakeholders.csv (private link)

leo: Telemetry checklist posted: sample telemetry we need: p50/p95/p99 latency per endpoint, 4xx/5xx breakdown, tokens per request histogram, average response size, model version tag on traces.

tess: SRE office hours set for Wed week 2 11am PT (invite out). Added a runbook link for retry/backoff best practices.

annie: Draft training deck uploaded to the Polaris folder. Will iterate after discovery meeting.

maya: Small risk update: procurement expects legal sign-off before the long-term PO. That workflow could take up to 2 weeks depending on their counsel. I've added a mitigation: propose parallel work (sandbox discovery + staged validation) so we don't block entirely on legal.

raj: Noted. I'll add a "legal dependency" column in the stakeholder sheet so we can track it.

maya: Recap:
- 30-day target with checkpoints: discovery (wk1), integration (wk2), validation (wk3), launch prep (wk4)
- Owners: raj (stakeholders), tess (PS infra), leo (product metrics), annie (enablement), maya (CS lead)
- Top risks: PO / legal delay, telemetry gaps, load-testing limitations in sandbox
- Mitigation: staged validation approach + SRE office hours

annie: I'll share the session invites and the post-session survey template after discovery.

onboard-bot: REMINDER: leo's telemetry checklist due in 24h.

maya: Thanks team. I'll send a short status note to Polaris and copy the AE. Please add blockers here.
